title: Agency Dealership vs. Approved Repair Facility
citation: Illustrative Motor Comprehensive Policy — Section 3 (Collision Repair), Clause 3.1
text: Accident repairs are performed at the manufacturer's authorized main dealership (Agency Repair) if the Agency Repair endorsement is selected in the schedule and the vehicle is within 3 years of first registration. For vehicles beyond this period or policies without agency cover, repairs are executed at insurer-certified independent collision centers meeting national quality standards.
